definitions.explanation: the process of making something simpler or less complex

examples.japanese: {手続|てつづ}きを{簡略化|かんりゃくか}する。
{説明|せつめい}を{簡略化|かんりゃくか}した{版|ばん}。
examples.english: A simplified version of the explanation.

examples.japanese: {業務|ぎょうむ}の{簡略化|かんりゃくか}で{効率|こうりつ}が{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Efficiency improved through simplification of operations.

notes:
{簡略化|かんりゃくか} refers to making processes or content simpler.

WRITING:
- {簡|かん} (simple, brief)
- {略|りゃく} (abbreviation, omission)
- {化|か} (-ization, change)

USAGE:
- {簡略化|かんりゃくか}する (to simplify - suru verb)
- {簡略化|かんりゃくか}された (simplified)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {手続|てつづ}きの{簡略化|かんりゃくか} (simplification of procedures)
- {業務|ぎょうむ}{簡略化|かんりゃくか} (work simplification)
- {表記|ひょうき}の{簡略化|かんりゃくか} (simplification of notation)

RELATED WORDS:
- {単純化|たんじゅんか} (simplification - similar meaning)
- {省略|しょうりゃく} (omission, abbreviation)
- {効率化|こうりつか} (making efficient)
- {合理化|ごうりか} (rationalization)
